fullExplanation.text: Understanding Joshua in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life

To study Joshua in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life, begin with the concrete claims made under Joshua. An independent Catholic study of Joshua focused on land, covenant fidelity, conquest, rest, and inheritance. It is an ordered account in which Scripture is interpreted, Magisterial teaching is classified, historical evidence is contextualised, and scholarship is used within its discipline.
